title: Ranking and Decoding Oracle Machines
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers and let a well-formed oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and state set of size $n$ be given. If this machine is assigned its index in the finite enumeration of such machines, then decoding the natural-number code obtained by pairing $k$, $n$, and that index returns the same finite oracle machine, with its three distinguished states and transition function unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: the table is a well-formed oracle machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and state type $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
the code uses the table's index under the specified finite enumeration
